external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Students in the Kindergarten and Primary sections benefit from an enhanced and tailored English curriculum from an early age. This learning opportunity is made possible thanks to donations from the association Les Amis du Verseau.
In Secondary school the Enhanced English Programme is provided as an extra-curricular activity through another of our not-for-profit partners, Verseau Sports, Arts & Langues (VSAL).
